note: One row per trial. Paper edits this file when a trial starts, is judged, wins, or is killed. 'live' keys are filled in by scripts/scoreboard.py at render time.

experiments.name: Momentum crypto v2 (BTC 50% core + top-2 alts) vs old top-4
experiments.hypothesis: A 50% BTC core plus the top 2 momentum alts beats the old equal top-4 momentum book.
experiments.rule: Revert if v2 trails the old book by more than 2 pts.
experiments.result_text: DECIDED 11/09: KEEP v2. Since 10/12 v2 -11.38% (NAV $21,793.16) vs old top-4 -15.18% (NAV $20,858.31). Gap +3.8 pts; rule was revert only if v2 trailed by >2 pts.

experiments.name: Relative-strength alt filter
experiments.hypothesis: An alt keeps its 15% slot only if its 63d return beats BTC's; otherwise the slot goes to BTC.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more than 2 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt or never diverges.
experiments.result_text: DECIDED 11/23: DROP. Final mark 09:33 ET: shadow -17.55% vs live v2 -16.88% since 10/26 (gap -0.67 pts); Monday drawdown shadow -17.55% vs v2 -17.07%. Gap ranged -0.28 to +0.79 pts during this morning alone, so no edge vs noise. Promote bar (+1.5 pts) never reached in 4 weeks; it only swaps alts for more BTC, which is the asset that is falling. The useful part (de-risk when alts are weak) is tested better by the BTC 200d trend gate (judge 12/14).

experiments.name: Mean-reversion equity satellite (up to 10%)
experiments.hypothesis: A weekly bottom-8 mean-reversion satellite adds return without adding drawdown.
experiments.control: Momentum book inside the same sleeve
experiments.result_text: 11/23: bottom 8 now JPM, IWM, QQQ, AVGO, EEM, GOOGL, GLD, NVDA. Sold 7 XLI (out of bottom 8, realized -$55.28), bought 3 JPM @ $318.22. Satellite 8.3% of equity NAV. Decide 12/07.
experiments.rule: Keep if satellite return since 11/02 beats the momentum book with no more than 1 pt extra sleeve drawdown; kill if it trails momentum by more than 2 pts.

experiments.name: Weekly shadow book vs monthly live equity
experiments.hypothesis: Monthly rebalancing does as well as weekly with less turnover.
experiments.control: Weekly 63d momentum + top-10 buffer, simulated, never booked
experiments.rule: Revert to weekly if live trails the shadow by more than 1.5 pts or adds more than 1 pt drawdown over the 4 monthly rebalances 11/02 to 02/01. First judge 11/02.
experiments.result_text: 11/23 (09:33 ET): live monthly -4.66% vs weekly shadow -4.29% since 10/19 (gap -0.37 pts, inside 1.5). Like-for-like Monday drawdown fixed: live -4.66% vs shadow -4.29% (0.37 pts more, inside 1). Shadow sold XLE (rank >10), bought TLT. Judge 12/07.

experiments.name: Active equity rotation funding (rule v9)
experiments.hypothesis: Selling the weakest trend to fund a stronger one fixes cash starvation and helps Active beat the baseline.
experiments.rule: Kill if rotations lose money on net over 4 weeks and Active falls behind the 50/50 baseline.
experiments.result_text: 11/23: still 2 rotations (AMZN to XLRE 11/10, XLB to XLU 11/13), none since. Rotation sells realized +$770.89, but the bought legs gave back: XLRE closed 11/19 at -$512.68, XLU about -$326 unrealized, so the pairs net about -$68. Active household still about +$13.9k vs the 50/50 baseline, so the kill rule (net loss AND behind baseline) is not met. Decide 11/30.

experiments.name: Kronos-small regime filter for crypto alts
experiments.hypothesis: Holding BTC instead of alts when Kronos paths are scattered (choppy) beats live v2.
experiments.result_text: 11/23: Marvin offline, no regime log; shadow marked at prior 80% BTC, not resized (third straight Monday). Shadow -14.59% vs live v2 -14.35% since 11/02 (gap -0.25 pts). Last readable labels (11/09) were all choppy or trending down. Decide 12/07; if the log is still unreadable then, judge on what exists or extend.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more than 2 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt or the regime label never changes.

experiments.name: Equal-weight universe at 80% invested (monthly)
experiments.hypothesis: Equal-weighting the equity universe at 80% invested beats live monthly momentum with less selection risk.
experiments.control: Live monthly momentum book (70%) + MR satellite (10%)
experiments.rule: Promote to a live satellite or core replacement study if it leads the live equity sleeve by >2 pts with no more than 1.5 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by >2 pts.
experiments.result_text: 11/23: shadow -3.28% vs live equity -2.87% since 11/09 (gap -0.41 pts). Decide 12/07.

experiments.name: BTC 200d trend gate for crypto
experiments.hypothesis: When BTC is below its 200-day SMA, holding 40% BTC and 60% cash (no alts) beats live v2 with less drawdown.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt.
experiments.result_text: 11/23: BTC $63,697 is 11.8% below its 200d SMA ($72,245), gate stays on (40% BTC, 60% cash). Shadow -0.32% vs live v2 +0.23% since 11/16 (gap -0.55 pts); pre-open the gap was +2.2 pts before the morning crypto bounce. Decide 12/14.

experiments.name: SPY core 40% + top-4 momentum (equity)
experiments.hypothesis: A 40% SPY core with the top-4 momentum names at 10% each (20% cash) beats the live 8-name monthly momentum book, which has trailed SPY over 1 to 3 years.
experiments.control: Live momentum equity sleeve (70% momentum + 10% MR satellite)
experiments.rule: Checkpoint 12/07. Promote at the 2027-01-04 first-Monday rebalance if it leads live equity by >1 pt with no more than 1 pt extra Monday drawdown; kill if it trails by >1.5 pts.
experiments.result_text: Started 11/23 09:33 ET from live equity NAV $97,352.77: SPY 40%, BRK-B, AAPL, XLP, XLV 10% each. Backtest (monthly, 10 bps): 1y +0.59% vs control -1.85%; 2y +11.94% vs +4.86%; 3y +40.60% vs +34.30%; 5y +52.75% vs +47.26%; 3m -7.65% vs -7.32%; 6m -10.39% vs -10.11%. Drawdown about equal, turnover about 40% lower.
